concurrent_read_errors.meaning: Wrong or failed readings with 8 threads reading at once (8 x 1000 reads)

driver_load_unload_cycles.meaning: Times the driver was loaded, used and removed without a problem

driver_read_latency_median_us.meaning: Time for one temperature read on the emulated board, including Python overhead (median); relative numbers only

driver_read_latency_p99_us.meaning: Time for one temperature read on the emulated board, including Python overhead (99th percentile); relative numbers only

guest_boot_to_tests_s.meaning: Seconds from kernel start to the start of the guest tests (emulated board)

kasan_reports.meaning: Invalid memory accesses (use-after-free, out of bounds) in the whole run

kmemleak_reports.meaning: Memory blocks our driver allocated and never freed (after 200 cycles)

kunit_cases_passed.meaning: Kernel-level checks of the conversion math (KUnit cases passed)

lockdep_reports.meaning: Locking mistakes that could deadlock, in the whole run
